text: Ordered during the evening downpour and the rider took 80 minutes. The fries were a soggy mess and the paneer sandwich had gone cold and rubbery.
Baarish mein order time pe aaya hi nahi. Pasta ekdum thanda, delivery bag bhi bheeg gaya tha. Bohot bura experience.
Stood in a wet queue for 18 minutes for a cappuccino I could have made faster at home. Counter staff did not even apologise.
Team lunch order of 14 items landed 90 minutes late in the rain, two lattes missing and the chai cups half empty.
Came in drenched, waited 40 minutes for a simple tea while staff chatted by the counter. No table, no apology, wet floor.
They sent a cappuccino instead of the latte I ordered and even that arrived cold. Rain delay on top of a wrong order.
Line itni lambi thi ki hum bahar hi bheeg gaye. Cheese toast ke liye 35 min wait kiya, phir seat bhi nahi mili.
Hot chocolate leaked through the cup into the bag, half of it gone and what remained was lukewarm. Waste of 230 rupees.
My usual butter croissant order arrived swapped for a blueberry muffin and the kraft bag was already soaking through at the seams.
Twenty minutes for a single espresso while it poured outside. Missed my bus and the shot was bitter anyway.
Three kids, one wet floor, fifty minutes for our food to show up. Nobody checked on us even once. We left hungry.
Cheesecake ulta ho ke aaya, glaze box ke lid pe chipak gaya. Rider ko baarish mein bohot time laga aur khana bigad gaya.
Everyone calls this place a hidden gem. My waffle arrived cold, the box was mush from the rain, and the maple had pooled at the bottom.
260 rupaye ka iced latte aur cup aadha bhara hua. Baarish mein 70 minute ka wait bhi, aur paisa full. Not coming back.
The strawberry shake survived the ride but the fries were steam-soft and cold. Half the order felt like a compromise.
Flat white reached my desk cold after a 70-minute crawl through the rain. Decent coffee, terrible logistics.
Sandwich bilkul thanda tha aur mint chutney packet hi nahi tha. Baarish ki wajah se late samajh aata hai, par itna nahi.
Food was bland and the kids' drinks came after we had finished eating. For a family dinner it was hard work.
Camped for two hours but the wifi kept dropping and the rain-day crowd was loud. The cold brew was the only win.
No labels on any cups, so twelve lattes and cappuccinos became a guessing game back at the office. Two were wrong entirely.
Rainy evening should have been perfect but our table was sticky, the floor was wet, and service crawled. v disappointing.
Price phir se badha diya lagta hai. Taste theek hai par student ke liye ab thoda mehenga ho gaya hai overall.
Blueberry muffin squash ho ke aaya, cold brew bottle ke neeche flat. Crumbs everywhere in the bag, kuch bhi shape mein nahi.
My usual has been thinner and weaker the last three visits. I keep coming out of habit now, not because it is still good.
Sab kuch lukewarm aaya - chilli cheese toast ek slab ban gaya tha. Baarish bahana hai har baar, pls do better.
Waited at the counter while two staff discussed the flap board. My drink finally came, no eye contact, no thanks.
Rainy evening so we ordered in. Waffle was decent but the fries were soft and the kids' shake had leaked into the bag.
Filter coffee ka taste accha tha jo bacha, par bag mein aadha spill ho gaya. Hotel tak pahunchte pahunchte sab geela.
Ninety minutes door to door in the rain; the pasta had soaked up its own sauce. The one bright spot was the patient rider.
Gorgeous pink corner on a rainy day and the waffle was crisp, but we waited 30 minutes and the queue blocked the door.
The arrabbiata tasted great, genuinely fiery, but it arrived barely warm. Would have been five stars fresh off the stove.
In and out in four minutes which I appreciate, but the croissant was fridge-cold. Pick one, brew: fast or fresh.
Chai aur fries saste aur tasty, par baarish ke din seats bilkul nahi milti. Kabhi kabhi khade hoke khana padta hai.
Cold brew was smooth as always and the wifi held up, but every plug was taken and I ended up battery-anxious for two hours.
Ten sandwiches reached the office on time despite the rain, but one was paneer tikka instead of the toast we asked for.
Fries arrived hot but the hot chocolate was barely warm - split right down the middle. At least nothing spilled in the rain.
My usual tastes different this week, less cardamom maybe. Still my favourite corner when it rains, just slightly off.
Adorable pink cafe, very photo-worthy, but the matcha was watery and not worth 290. Come for the vibe, not that drink.
Strawberry shake was a hit with the kids but the fries took twenty minutes and landed after everything else.
Neat kraft packaging, very tidy, but the latte had still leaked a little into the bag and was lukewarm by arrival.
Cheese toast theek tha, price bhi ok, par portion chhota hai. Do khane padenge agar asli bhookh lagi ho.
Delivery was quick even in the drizzle but the muffin was dry, like it had sat in the display since morning.
Rider was polite and kept me updated through the rain; the paneer sandwich itself was only warm-ish. Mixed bag, literally.
Watching the rain from the window seat was lovely. The cheesecake was a sugar bomb though, the glaze overpowered everything.
Stayed three hours on one coffee and a pastry; wifi was fine but the bench seat gets uncomfortable very fast.
The bags reached the office on time, but two cups had tipped sideways inside and soaked every napkin.
Time pe aaya order, par waffle pura soggy tha. Maple syrup ka kya fayda jab base hi galav ho jaye.
Fries aur peri-peri dust ka taste solid hai, par box mein steam se soft ho gaye the jab tak pahunche.
Filter coffee is the real deal, proper dabarah froth. Table was sticky and the floor had muddy footprints though.
Staff warned us one dish was too spicy for the kids and suggested a cooler drink instead. Sweet of them; the food itself was just okay.
Rain slowed the whole counter down but the cappuccino was worth the extra ten minutes. Foam was textbook.
Avocado toast tastes fresh and the chilli crunch slaps, but 380 for that size stings a little on a delivery order.
Quiet window corner as always. Today's pour was weaker than usual though, like somebody rushed the steep.
Flat white ready in three minutes even with the rain crowd at the door. A touch steep at 240 but consistent every time.
Cosy rainy evening done right - hot chocolate with marshmallows and a crisp-edged waffle. Only gripe: music a notch loud.
Sandwich reached still warm through the downpour, kraft bag sealed tight. A little late but honestly impressive.
Chai 140 mein mast, fries bhi crispy. Baarish mein bheed zyada thi isliye seat ke liye thoda wait karna pada.
Cold brew plus a plug point and steady wifi got me through a deadline while it poured outside. Chair could be softer.
The kids demolished their drinks and dinner; staff brought extra napkins without being asked. Mild wait but they warned us.
All 16 cups labelled by name, bags stapled shut, only ten minutes late in heavy rain. Office admin approved.
Filter coffee in a dabarah while rain hammered the window - peak Bengaluru. Wish the tables were not all two-seaters.
Usual cappuccino, usual heart pour, ready before I finished paying. Consistency is why I keep walking over.
Fries ka crunch bacha tha aur iced latte ne bag bhi nahi bhigaya. Wet evening ke liye packaging on point.
My drink was genuinely pretty and tasted like it looked. Table wobbled a bit, but the rainy window view made up for it.
Kulhad chai jaldi mila, garam bhi ekdum. 140 mein itna accha chai aur kahin nahi milega. Bas thodi line thi.
Nobody rushed me for three hours, refills were easy, wifi held steady. Noise picked up around lunch but manageable.
Arrabbiata arrived properly hot on a properly wet night. Sauce had not split, penne still had bite. Portion chhota tha bas.
Counter moved fast even with everyone hiding from the rain inside. In and out in six minutes, drink pulled well.
Staff were patient while the kids decided between drinks. Food came out fast and hot, and the bill was fair.
Collected twelve sandwiches and filter coffees; every label correct, bag handles double-taped for the rain. Tiny wait.
Masala chai in a kulhad on a rainy afternoon is a whole mood. Friendly counter too. Slightly cramped inside.
Kabir remembered my usual order before I even spoke. Small thing, but it is why this place feels like mine.
Cheesecake arrived chilled and intact, glaze still glossy. One corner of the box was dented, nothing tragic.
Warm cinnamon roll, rain on the glass, brown-butter smell everywhere. Coffee a touch bitter today, still a good hour.
Plugs mile, bill split bhi easy ho gaya, cheese toast sahi tha. Bas thodi garmi kam thi andar aaj.
Refill without a lecture on table time - appreciated. Wifi dipped twice but came back fast both times.
Rider beat the rain and landed my cappuccino at the office in 25 minutes, microfoam still holding. Impressive.
Rose milk travelled surprisingly well, sabja seeds still separate, bottle cold. Delivery took a while in the rain though.
Grabbed a butter croissant for the walk; still warm at 11am. Flaky enough to leave a trail down the street.
They pushed two tables together for our four without any fuss. Everything landed together so nobody waited hungry.
Strawberry cheesecake is basque-style done right, burnt edges and all. Rain made the pink walls feel extra warm.
Iced latte aur fries teen logon ne split kiye - decent value, baarish mein thoda late aaya par sab bach gaya.
Delivery for the whole floor: every cup still steaming, napkins and spoons included without asking. One label had smudged.
Quick espresso and a blueberry muffin before the metro; soaked outside, dry inside, out in five. Good pitstop.
Cinnamon roll arrived still warm, icing packed separately so it did not melt into a mess. Thoughtful packing.
The split-flap Now Brewing board is such a fun touch and my drink was genuinely lovely. Rainy afternoon well spent.
Waffle with maple, rain drumming the window, nobody hurrying us to leave - this is what weekends are for.
Cappuccino in four minutes flat at 8:30, heart intact, lid sealed tight for the wet walk. Perfect pitstop.
Ordering in the rain is a gamble but this arrived hot, dry and neatly packed. The paneer sandwich still had crunch.
Meera had my usual going the second I walked in, drenched. A towel appeared too. This place is home.
Baarish, kulhad chai aur cheese toast - 400 ke andar full satisfaction. brew kabhi disappoint nahi karta.
Three hours, two refills, zero side-eye. Wifi fast, plug at my table, rain outside. Best office in Indiranagar.
Staff moved tables for us, warned that one dish was spicy for the kids, and the drinks came first. Thoughtful service.
Filter coffee frothed in the dabarah right at the counter. Watched the rain, drank slowly, took a muffin for later.
Hot chocolate ghar tak actually hot pahuncha, marshmallows alag pack mein the taaki dissolve na ho. Detail-obsessed.
Rose latte and strawberry cheesecake on a wet Sunday - the kind of hour you plan your whole week around.
Espresso pulled in front of me, out the door in three minutes. The 8am queue moves like a machine here.
Twenty items for the team, every single one labelled and hot on arrival despite the weather. Flawless bulk order.
Croissant still warm, flat white in hand, umbrella under the other arm. Four-minute ritual, never misses.
Fries crispy, peri-peri masala ekdum sahi, aur price bhi student-friendly. Baarish mein best adda hai ye.
Cold brew travelled perfectly, ice still intact, orange twist fresh. The rain could not touch it. Reordering tomorrow.
The flap board clicking over to a fresh brew while it pours outside is tiny theatre. My pastry was divine too.
Four of us, two joined tables, warm drinks all round. The kids were already planning the next visit before we left.
Caught a storm-day deadline here. Strong coffee, stable wifi, and staff who refilled my water without being asked.
Flat white to my desk in under 30 minutes, still hot despite the flooded street outside. Best rainy-day decision.
Pink walls, monsoon outside, staff who happily walked me through the menu - the most Bengaluru hour of my trip.
Waffle box had a vent so it stayed crisp, maple in a little pot. Whoever designed the delivery packing deserves a raise.
Split three ways: chai, cheese toast, fries - under 600 total and a dry window table for an hour. Paisa vasool.
Zoya remembered I take my usual a little hotter. Nineteen months of visits and they still notice. Rare.
Rain outside, jazz inside, and a warm mug I did not want to finish. Did not want the evening to end.
Matcha arrived still whisked-frothy, which I did not think was possible on a scooter ride. Bottle sealed tight.
Rain cancelled our park plan; brew saved the evening. Kids got their treats, we got hot drinks, everyone won.
Office chai run for twelve: every cup labelled, carrier bag held up in the rain, all still hot. Zero complaints.
Rained all afternoon; I worked all afternoon. Easy refills, a dry window seat, and nobody hovering for the table.
Rain or shine the counter runs like clockwork here. My cup was nearly ready before the ticket printed.
Grabbed a rose milk for the wet walk to the metro - chilled, floral, with sabja. Charming little place.
Baarish mein ghar baithe chai aur cheese toast time pe aaya. Bill bhi budget mein. Perfection.
Dev sent my toast out bubbling and extra crisp because he knows I like it that way. Attention like that is rare.
Cinnamon roll garam aaya aur icing alag cup mein thi taaki melt na ho. Genius detail, delicious result.
Sat by the window with a warm drink and something sweet while it poured. Quiet, pink, perfect.
